{{Header Nav|game=Red Dead Redemption}}

Just like in the single player of ''Red Dead Redemption'', you can call your mount in the multiplayer too. This is invaluable in free mode, and can be a real advantage if you choose to call in your mount during a competitive match. As you progress through the ranks, you can unlock new mounts which are faster and have more stamina.

== El Señor ==
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 1
 
The first mount unlocked is '''El Señor''', a mule which has limited stamina and poor speed. It is available to players from the initial rank.

== Lusitano Nag ==
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 4

The '''Lusitano Nag''' is unlocked at Rank 4. This is slightly faster and larger than the mule, but is still a very poor mount.

== Turkmen ==
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 8

The '''Turkmen''' is the third mount unlocked in multiplayer, at Rank 8. It appears visibly stronger and larger than the Lusitano Nag, and it is also much faster.

== Cleveland Bay ==
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 22

The '''Cleveland Bay''' mount is unlocked at Rank 22. It has medium speed and stamina.
